name: hero-globe
title: Globe split hero
description: Split hero with copy, CTAs and live stats beside an interactive dotted globe with arcs.

standards.purpose: Open the page with its single promise and one obvious next step.
useWhen: A page needs its opening statement of value.
A cold visitor must understand the product in one screen.
doNotUseWhen: The surface is an app screen or dashboard — no marketing hero inside tools.
The page already opened with another hero.

rules.check: At most two actions, and at most one of them is the primary action.
The hero carries the page's only h1; a second hero on the page is a violation.
Stats, logos, and screenshots must be real or explicitly labeled as illustrative.
